كَمَدٌ (L, K) and ↓ كَمْدٌ (K) and ↓ كُمْدَةٌ , (S, L, Msb, K,) the last a simple subst., (Msb,) Change of colour, (S, L, Msb, K,) and loss of its clearness, (L, K,) the traces thereof remaining. (L.) ―
-b2- كَمَدٌ Concealed grief or sorrow: (S, A, L, Msb:) or grief or sorrow which one cannot dispel: (L:) or intense grief; as also ↓ كَمْدٌ and ↓ كُمْدَةٌ : (K:) or most intense grief or sorrow: (ISd, L:) and disease of the heart from intense grief or sorrow. (K.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
